titulo: Milestone sensor upgrade enhances Space Force identifying, tracking capability
descricao: July 31, 2025 Milestone sensor upgrade enhances Space Force identifying, tracking capability Space Operations Command, in partnership with Space Systems Command, approved the operational acceptance of a milestone upgrade to the Ground-Based Optical Sensor System at the Ground-based Electro-Optical Deep Space Surveillance site in White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico.

titulo: CMSSF strengthens allied partnerships during first European tour
descricao: July 30, 2025 CMSSF strengthens allied partnerships during first European tour The visit marked Bentivegna’s first official multi-nation tour of the EUCOM AOR since assuming the top enlisted position in the U.S. Space Force.

titulo: US Space Force scheduled to launch eighth X-37B mission
descricao: July 28, 2025 US Space Force scheduled to launch eighth X-37B mission The U.S. Space Force, in partnership with the Air Force Rapid Capabilities Office, is scheduled to launch the eighth mission of the X-37B Orbital Test Vehicle (OTV-8) on Aug. 21, 2025, from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.

titulo: SecAF visits Asia-Pacific to strengthen alliances, assess readiness
descricao: July 25, 2025 SecAF visits Asia-Pacific to strengthen alliances, assess readiness Secretary of the Air Force Troy E. Meink departed July 24 on his first international trip as SecAF, traveling throughout the U.S. Asia-Pacific area of responsibility to reinforce international partnerships and meet with Airmen and Guardians supporting the 2025 Department-Level Exercise.

titulo: Vandenberg SFB hosts NASA TRACERS mission brief
descricao: July 25, 2025 Vandenberg SFB hosts NASA TRACERS mission brief Vandenberg Space Force Base hosted a mission brief for NASA’s upcoming Tandem Reconnection and Cusp Electrodynamics Reconnaissance Satellites mission.

titulo: Senate confirms Lohmeier to be nation’s 29th Air Force Under Secretary
descricao: July 24, 2025 Senate confirms Lohmeier to be nation’s 29th Air Force Under Secretary Mr. Matthew Lohmeier was confirmed as the 29th Under Secretary of the Air Force.

titulo: DAF kicks off department-level exercise series in Pacific
descricao: July 8, 2025 DAF kicks off department-level exercise series in Pacific The Department of the Air Force launched its Pacific-focused first-in-a-generation Department-Level Exercise series today in multiple locations across the United States and Indo-Pacific areas of responsibility.

titulo: US Space Force unveils International Partnership Strategy to strengthen space security
descricao: July 8, 2025 US Space Force unveils International Partnership Strategy to strengthen space security The U.S. Space Force released its inaugural International Partnership Strategy July 8, outlining a comprehensive vision for deepening collaboration with allies and partners to ensure a secure, stable and sustainable space domain.

titulo: Space Systems Command set to strengthen operational environment with enhanced global weather sensing
descricao: July 3, 2025 Space Systems Command set to strengthen operational environment with enhanced global weather sensing Space Systems Command laid the groundwork for enhanced weather, research, development and prototyping capabilities with the USSF-178 National Security Space Launch Phase 3 Lane 1 task order.

titulo: Nobody wins alone: A community mindset approach
descricao: July 2, 2025 Nobody wins alone: A community mindset approach The Year of the Company Grade Officer focuses on the junior officer corps — aiming to expand pride in service through building an empowered culture of discipline, ownership, excellence and proactive leadership.

titulo: US Space Force launches Civilian Human Capital Evaluation and Accountability Program
descricao: July 1, 2025 US Space Force launches Civilian Human Capital Evaluation and Accountability Program Developed to drive continuous improvement, the Civilian Human Capital Evaluation and Accountability Program leverages data to assess and enhance the effectiveness, efficiency and compliance of human capital programs across the force.

titulo: Air Force and Space Force exceed annual recruiting goals, demonstrating Americans’ desire to serve
descricao: June 30, 2025 Air Force and Space Force exceed annual recruiting goals, demonstrating Americans’ desire to serve The Department of the Air Force achieved 100% of its annual recruitment goal three months ahead of schedule, a testament to the enduring appeal of service and the effectiveness of modernized recruiting strategies.

titulo: Meink, Allvin, Saltzman outline strategies, priorities necessary to secure the nation
descricao: June 26, 2025 Meink, Allvin, Saltzman outline strategies, priorities necessary to secure the nation DAF senior leaders highlighted the recent U.S. strike on Iran as a vivid example for what is possible – but also at risk – unless Congress ensures sufficient, uninterrupted funding for the Air Force and Space Force.

titulo: USSPACECOM DCOM highlights strategic partnerships at Prague Security Space Conference
descricao: June 26, 2025 USSPACECOM DCOM highlights strategic partnerships at Prague Security Space Conference Lt. Gen. Thomas James, U.S. Space Command deputy commander, attended the Prague Security Studies Institute’s 8th Prague Space Security Conference in the Czech Republic, June 15-17.

titulo: Families invited to take on national summer reading challenge
descricao: June 25, 2025 Families invited to take on national summer reading challenge A nationwide reading program was created to encourage kindergarten through eighth-grade students to read 12 books during the summer break.

titulo: DAF joins with Disney, Pixar to bring military family story to life in ‘Elio’
descricao: June 24, 2025 DAF joins with Disney, Pixar to bring military family story to life in ‘Elio’ Ahead of the movie's theatrical release, Disney/Pixar invited military families to special screenings across the country, including at an event hosted by the Motion Picture Association in Washington, D.C.

titulo: Guardians strengthen multinational partnerships and demonstrate electronic warfare during African Lion 2025
descricao: May 28, 2025 Guardians strengthen multinational partnerships and demonstrate electronic warfare during African Lion 2025 U.S. Space Forces Europe – Space Forces Africa is advancing multinational collaboration and readiness by bringing cutting-edge space-based capabilities and electromagnetic warfare expertise to exercise African Lion 2025.

descricao: May 27, 2025 Operational Test Launch GT 253 is a 'Glory Trip' for wing An unarmed Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile launched during operational test Glory Trip 253: An operational test designed to verify the accuracy and reliability of the United States’ land-based nuclear deterrent.

descricao: May 27, 2025 Minuteman III test launch showcases readiness of US nuclear force's safe, effective deterrent A joint team of AFGSC Airmen launched an unarmed Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile equipped with a single Mark-21 High Fidelity Re-Entry Vehicle May 21 from Vandenberg SFB, Calif.

titulo: Space Force Year in Photos

titulo: A promise fulfilled: A story of service, legacy and love
descricao: Dec. 30, 2025 A promise fulfilled: A story of service, legacy and love U.S. Space Force 2nd Lt. Kimo Martinez, who survived the 2016 Brussels Airport bombing, tells his profound story of recovery and his journey to becoming an officer in the United States Space Force.

titulo: US Space Forces Japan celebrates first year of activation
descricao: Dec. 23, 2025 US Space Forces Japan celebrates first year of activation As the newest independent service in the War Department and a newly activated component in the Indo-Pacific region, this small but essential team of Guardians advances space expertise for Japan and joint partners.

titulo: Hegseth, senior leaders honor military's top recruiters
descricao: Dec. 19, 2025 Hegseth, senior leaders honor military's top recruiters Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and other senior War Department officials honored the military's top recruiters during the inaugural Recruitment Excellence Forum at the Pentagon.

descricao: Dec. 19, 2025 CSO delivers birthday message to Guardians CSO Saltzman delivers his annual birthday message to Guardians.

titulo: SLD 45, KSC, NASA host Reverse Industry Day to shape future of space launch
descricao: Dec. 18, 2025 SLD 45, KSC, NASA host Reverse Industry Day to shape future of space launch Space Launch Delta 45, Kennedy Space Center and NASA recently hosted a Reverse Industry Day, bringing together commercial launch providers to discuss the future of space launch operations on the Eastern Range.

titulo: Space Systems Command stands up System Delta 80
descricao: Dec. 18, 2025 Space Systems Command stands up System Delta 80 Space Systems Command activated System Delta 80 to support the Assured Access to Space (AATS) Program Executive Office portfolio. This activation synchronizes acquisition efforts that support the nation’s mobility in, from, and to space.

descricao: Dec. 16, 2025 DAF updates medical shaving profile guidance to align with Secretary of War grooming policy The Department of the Air Force updated its medical guidance for shaving profiles to align with the Secretary of War’s grooming standards.

descricao: Dec. 12, 2025 CMSSF highlights evolving warfighter demands, space threats at Spacepower 2025 CMSSF Bentivegna emphasized the critical yet often unseen role of space in modern conflict and the qualities demanded of today's Guardians during the Space Force Association’s Spacepower Conference.

titulo: Remarks by CSO Gen. Chance Saltzman at the 2025 Space Force Association’s Spacepower Conference
descricao: Dec. 11, 2025 Remarks by CSO Gen. Chance Saltzman at the 2025 Space Force Association’s Spacepower Conference As delivered by CSO Gen. Chance Saltzman at the 2025 Space Force Association’s Spacepower Conference.

descricao: Dec. 11, 2025 SPACEFOREUR-AF team competes in Guardian Arena for the first time United States Space Forces Europe-Space Forces Africa Guardians and Airmen, assigned to Ramstein Air Base, Germany, competed in the third annual Guardian Arena at Patrick SFB, Fla., Dec. 8-9.
